description: Point-in-time evidence about the hosted production project, used as a fixture by scripts/reconcile/reconcile-migrations.mjs. That script never connects to a hosted database. Nothing here proves the current live schema: every item is a dated observation and must be re-confirmed by an authorised read-only probe before any rollout.

ledgerSummary.source: Supabase migration-history metadata, read once on 2026-11-10 before the Phase 0 access restriction.
observations: No entry is dated 2026-11-09 or later.
Many entries carry console-generated versions, several names repeat, and some names do not exist in the repository (for example initial_schema, trial_entitlements, counter_orders, cash_collection).
Because production SQL was applied under other names and versions, 'no same-named entry' does not prove a file's SQL was never run.

catalogFacts.source: PHASE-2-PRODUCTION-PREFLIGHT.md and PHASE-2-PRODUCTION-MANIFEST.md in this repository (read-only catalog inspection recorded by the Phase 2 session). Not re-observed in Phase 0.
functionsPresent: place_public_order with six arguments, executable by anon
notes: Four financial function bodies lacked the 'FOR UPDATE OF s' pattern introduced by 20261110000100 and 20261110000200.
Production function-body hashes differed from the staging bodies, so staging is not an exact production rehearsal.

The Phase 2 document reports a user-run restore of a production dump that accepted the 14 files 20261109000100..20261110000400 in one transaction after the place_order overload fix. That rehearsal was not observed by any agent and did not include the four 202611080070..10 files or anything added in Phase 0.

repositoryFilesWithoutSameNamedEntry.method: Each repository file name (without its version) was compared with the names in the ledger. Files dated after lastRecordedVersion that are NOT listed here did have a same-named entry under another version.
repositoryFilesWithoutSameNamedEntry.note: 20261110000300 and 20261110000400 were not in the checkout when names were matched; their absence from the ledger is stated in PHASE-2-PRODUCTION-PREFLIGHT.md.
